user_requirements:
系统名称: ByWireChassisSystem
系统描述: 实现全线控底盘（转向、制动、悬架）
组件数量: 10
组件类型: SteerByWire, BrakeByWire, SuspensionControl, TorqueVectoring, RedundancyManager, SafetyController, SensorHub, ActuatorHub, MotionPlanner, HMIFeedback
关键需求:
  - SteerByWire实现无机械连接转向
  - BrakeByWire实现电子制动
  - SuspensionControl实现主动悬架
  - TorqueVectoring实现扭矩矢量分配
  - RedundancyManager管理双冗余系统
  - SafetyController实现ASIL-D安全监控
  - SensorHub聚合12路传感器数据
  - ActuatorHub控制8个电机执行器
  - MotionPlanner规划车辆运动
  - HMIFeedback提供力反馈和振动提示
  - 所有安全关键组件需双路冗余

system_analysis.functional_decomposition: 将系统划分为感知（SensorHub）、执行（ActuatorHub）、规划（MotionPlanner）、控制（SteerByWire、BrakeByWire、SuspensionControl、TorqueVectoring）、冗余与安全（RedundancyManager、SafetyController）、人机反馈（HMIFeedback）。SensorHub聚合12路传感器并提供统一数据总线；MotionPlanner基于传感器与策略生成运动参考；控制组件消费参考并生成执行器命令；ActuatorHub负责下发与状态采集；RedundancyManager维护双路数据与投票；SafetyController执行ASIL-D监控和安全切换；HMIFeedback提供触觉与力反馈。模块边界以数据所有权与安全职责划分，安全关键路径双路冗余，控制回路低延迟、确定性。
system_analysis.data_flow_analysis: SensorHub -> (SensorData SENDER-RECEIVER) -> MotionPlanner, SafetyController, TorqueVectoring, SteerByWire, BrakeByWire, SuspensionControl. MotionPlanner -> (MotionCommand CLIENT-SERVER / SENDER-RECEIVER) -> SteerByWire, BrakeByWire, TorqueVectoring, SuspensionControl. Controllers -> (ActuatorCommand CLIENT-SERVER / SYNCHRONOUS CALL) -> ActuatorHub. ActuatorHub -> (ActuatorStatus SENDER-RECEIVER) -> Controllers, RedundancyManager, SafetyController. RedundancyManager <-> SafetyController (synchronization and vote). HMIFeedback subscribes to status and sends HMI commands. 数据类型明确为：SensorData (array of sensor samples, timestamped), MotionCommand (trajectory points, speed, yaw), ActuatorCommand (torque/position setpoints), ActuatorStatus (position, torque, health), SafetyEvents (fault codes), RedundancyState (vote result). 传输时序：传感器周期1-10ms，控制环路5-20ms，规划周期20-100ms，冗余同步低延迟<5ms。接口按发送者-接收者或客户端-服务器划分以贴合AUTOSAR通信模型。
system_analysis.timing_requirements: 感知汇聚周期1-10ms；低级控制环路（Steer/Brake/Suspension/Torque）响应周期5-20ms，最坏阻塞延时 <10ms；MotionPlanner周期20-100ms；ActuatorHub应保证命令下发确认<5ms；冗余同步与心跳周期10ms，切换判决<15ms；SafetyController故障反应时间<5ms且满足ASIL-D分配的监控频率。
system_analysis.scalability_considerations: 组件采用清晰的接口与消息分离，SensorHub与ActuatorHub可横向扩展以支持更多传感器/执行器；通信采用按主题分离的S/R接口，方便增加新消费者；冗余与健康监测模块支持增加冗余通道与投票策略；整体架构能扩展到更多控制功能与更多ECU分布式部署。

component_plan.name: SensorHub
component_plan.purpose: 聚合12路传感器原始数据，时间戳与滤波，发布统一SensorData主题，提供诊断与冗余同步。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性采样与预处理；采样周期1-10ms；对每路传感器应用去噪与时间对齐；发布最新值与缓冲历史用于回放；维护数据质量指标与故障标识并上报。

ports.details: 输入P端口用于传感器采样，R端口用于向上层发布SensorData与HealthStatus

preselect.notes: 读取原始传感器端口数据

elements.notes: 接收和缓存传感器原始样本

preselect.notes: 读取状态变量进行健康评估

component_plan.name: ActuatorHub
component_plan.purpose: 接收控制命令并下发到8个电机执行器，采集执行器状态并反馈，支持远端同步与确认。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 以同步调用方式接收命令并产生确认；维护命令队列与最新值策略；执行器环路周期1-10ms；错误检测与本地安全限幅；提供点对点操作接口供控制器调用。

ports.details: PR端口用于同步操作调用（客户端-服务器），P端口用于状态发布

preselect.notes: 同步接收控制器命令并返回确认

component_plan.name: MotionPlanner
component_plan.purpose: 基于传感器数据、车辆状态与策略生成运动参考轨迹与速度目标，提供给下游控制器。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性规划（20-100ms），支持事件触发的紧急重规划；执行轨迹生成、碰撞/约束检查、动态可行性调整；输出时间戳轨迹点与置信度指标。

ports.details: P端口订阅SensorData，R端口发布MotionCommand

elements.notes: 读取感知数据并计算轨迹
向控制器发布规划结果

component_plan.name: SteerByWire
component_plan.purpose: 实现无机械连接的电控转向，接受规划与驾驶输入，输出转向电机命令，提供力反馈闭环。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 主控制周期5-10ms；融合驾驶意图与规划，运行横向控制算法（PID/LQR），进行状态估计与限幅；当故障发生触发冗余切换与降级策略；输出命令并请求ActuatorHub同步执行。

ports.details: P端口订阅MotionCommand与SensorData，PR端口用于同步调用ActuatorHub

runnables.name: Steer_Control_Runnable
runnables.notes: 横向控制执行、命令下发与确认处理

component_plan.name: BrakeByWire
component_plan.purpose: 实现电子制动逻辑，生成制动扭矩命令并与ActuatorHub交互，保证制动安全与故障降级。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 控制周期5-20ms；融合驾驶与规划命令，执行制动分配与ABS/ESC协同，支持紧急刹车逻辑；发生故障触发冗余投票并进入安全模式。

ports.details: 订阅制动相关输入，PR端口用于与ActuatorHub同步调用

runnables.name: Brake_Control_Runnable

preselect.notes: 向ActuatorHub下发制动命令并等待确认

runnables.notes: 计算制动力并发出命令

component_plan.name: SuspensionControl
component_plan.purpose: 实现主动悬架控制，基于路况与车辆动态调整悬架策略以提升稳定性与舒适性。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 控制周期10-20ms；执行状态估计、力/位置控制与故障限幅；提供模式切换（舒适/运动），在故障时降级为被动模式。

ports.details: 订阅路况与运动目标，PR端口用于下发到ActuatorHub

component_plan.name: TorqueVectoring
component_plan.purpose: 执行扭矩矢量分配算法以改善牵引与转向性能，生成多轮驱动命令并协调制动分配。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性10-20ms运行矢量分配优化；考虑车辆动力学约束与轮间差速；在故障时退化到安全牵引策略；与BrakeByWire协同分配制动力。

ports.details: 订阅规划与车辆状态，PR端口用于下发各轮Actuator命令

component_plan.name: RedundancyManager
component_plan.purpose: 管理双路冗余通道、健康投票、仲裁与状态同步，提供切换决策给安全关键组件。

port_estimates.input_ports: Channels status, Heartbeats, Component health reports
port_estimates.output_ports: Vote results, Switch commands, Sync state

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性与事件驱动健康检查（周期10ms），运行投票逻辑、仲裁策略并发出切换命令；提供API供控制组件查询和订阅冗余决策；保证一致性并记录切换事件。

ports.details: P端口用于接收心跳与健康，R端口用于发布投票结果与切换命令

preselect.notes: 读取各通道状态用于投票
发布投票结果与切换命令

component_plan.name: SafetyController
component_plan.purpose: 执行ASIL-D级别的安全监控、故障诊断、安全策略与安全切换命令的下发。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 持续监控关键参数（周期<=5ms），对异常执行快速反应、降级与切换；维护完整的诊断日志；与RedundancyManager协同完成安全切换；满足ASIL-D时间与隔离要求。

ports.details: P端口订阅各类状态与心跳，R端口发布安全事件与模式切换

preselect.notes: 读取关键状态变量用于安全判定

component_plan.name: HMIFeedback
component_plan.purpose: 提供力反馈与振动提示，将控制器的反馈信号转换为HMI驱动命令并接收HMI输入。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 基于力反馈与状态生成触觉指令，周期10-50ms；支持优先级策略与抑制；处理司机干预并回传事件；错误隔离，确保非关键路径失败不影响控制器。

ports.details: 订阅反馈信号并发布HMI驱动命令

preselect.notes: 读取控制器力反馈数据

interface_plan.name: SensorData
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous publish/subscribe, latest-value semantics with optional small history buffer for replay, period 1-10ms, delivery latency <5ms; error handling: sequence numbers and checksum, health flags.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: SensorHub发布周期1-10ms；端到端延迟<5ms；丢包重试与质量标记。
interface_plan.direct_paths: SensorHub -> MotionPlanner/Controllers directly via S/R bus

interface_plan.name: MotionCommand
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous with periodic updates and event-triggered immediate updates; frequency 20-100ms; latest-value with short queue; error handling: validity flag and fallback to safe stop.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: Planner -> Controllers latency <20ms; if delayed use last-known safe command.

interface_plan.name: ActuatorCommand
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Synchronous client-server calls for command delivery with acknowledgment; timeout <5ms; queued requests for non-blocking callers; error handling: retries, failover to redundant actuator or safe stop.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 命令确认<5ms；丢失或超时触发安全路径与冗余切换。

interface_plan.name: ActuatorStatus
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous periodic status publish (1-10ms) with latest-value semantics and heartbeat; health flags and error codes included; buffer small queue for missed samples.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 状态更新时间1-10ms；重要事件立即发布。

interface_plan.name: RedundancySync
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Low-latency periodic sync and heartbeat (10ms) with voting messages; deterministic delivery prioritized; error handling: majority vote and fallback commands.
interface_plan.direct_paths: RedundancyManager publishes sync and switch commands to subscribers

interface_plan.name: SafetyEvents
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous event-driven; high-priority channel for safety alerts; immediate delivery required (<5ms) and ack where needed; buffering limited, persistent logging.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 关键事件传递延迟<5ms，要求接收端处理并返回确认。

interface_plan.name: Haptic_Interface
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous periodic or event-driven; rate 10-50ms; latest-value semantics; degradation: reduce frequency under load.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 力反馈命令延迟<20ms以保证触感连贯。

connection_topology.component_connections: SensorHub publishes SensorData to MotionPlanner, SafetyController and controllers. MotionPlanner publishes MotionCommand to SteerByWire, BrakeByWire, SuspensionControl and TorqueVectoring. Controllers perform synchronous calls to ActuatorHub for ActuatorCommand. ActuatorHub publishes ActuatorStatus back to controllers and Safety/Redundancy. RedundancyManager exchanges heartbeat and vote messages with SensorHub, ActuatorHub and controllers. HMIFeedback subscribes to ForceFeedback and publishes Haptic commands. SafetyController subscribes broadly and issues SafetyEvents and ModeSwitchCommands.
connection_topology.data_flow_paths: SensorHub -> MotionPlanner (SensorData); MotionPlanner -> Controllers (MotionCommand); Controllers -> ActuatorHub (ActuatorCommand via synchronous calls); ActuatorHub -> Controllers (ActuatorStatus); RedundancyManager <-> components (RedundancySync); SafetyController -> all (SafetyEvents); SteerByWire -> HMIFeedback (Haptic).
connection_topology.control_flow_paths: MotionPlanner triggers control commands; Controllers synchronously invoke ActuatorHub operations; RedundancyManager can command mode switches to controllers; SafetyController can preempt controllers by issuing ModeSwitchCommands and SafetyEvents; HMIFeedback provides driver interaction events back to MotionPlanner and controllers.

architecture_rationale.design_decisions: 采用以SensorHub/ActuatorHub为数据聚合点的中心化发布/订阅结构，结合客户端-服务器同步用于确定性命令下发。将冗余管理与安全控制分离为独立服务以便复用与集中审计。安全关键路径采用双路冗余与投票策略，时间关键组件满足低延迟约束。采用S/R接口简化多消费者场景，C/S接口满足命令确认要求。
architecture_rationale.tradeoff_analysis: 中心化Hub简化数据一致性与扩展性，但增加单点实现复杂度；将冗余逻辑集中可统一策略但需保证其可靠性；使用同步调用保证命令可确认但增加实时性要求与可能阻塞，故对ActuatorHub要求严格的实时性能与隔离。
architecture_rationale.alternative_considerations: 可选分布式对等架构以减少Hub压力，但会增加组件间耦合与版本管理复杂度；将冗余决策下放到每个控制器可降低中心负载，但难以保证全局一致性。也可采用完全事件驱动命令而非同步调用，但会降低命令确认能力。
architecture_rationale.risk_assessment: 主要风险为ActuatorHub或RedundancyManager成为性能或可靠性瓶颈；为此在Round2需定义严格资源与时间预算并支持横向扩展与硬件隔离。安全Controller实现错误或投票逻辑瑕疵会导致错误切换，需严格验证与ASIL-D流程。网络丢包与延迟风险通过心跳、序号和超时处理缓解。

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 控制周期10-20ms；执行状态估计、力/位置控制与故障限幅；提供模式切换（舒适/运动），在故障时降级为被动模式。

ports.details: 订阅路况与运动目标，PR端口用于下发到ActuatorHub

component_plan.name: TorqueVectoring
component_plan.purpose: 执行扭矩矢量分配算法以改善牵引与转向性能，生成多轮驱动命令并协调制动分配。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性10-20ms运行矢量分配优化；考虑车辆动力学约束与轮间差速；在故障时退化到安全牵引策略；与BrakeByWire协同分配制动力。

ports.details: 订阅规划与车辆状态，PR端口用于下发各轮Actuator命令

component_plan.name: RedundancyManager
component_plan.purpose: 管理双路冗余通道、健康投票、仲裁与状态同步，提供切换决策给安全关键组件。

port_estimates.input_ports: Channels status, Heartbeats, Component health reports
port_estimates.output_ports: Vote results, Switch commands, Sync state

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性与事件驱动健康检查（周期10ms），运行投票逻辑、仲裁策略并发出切换命令；提供API供控制组件查询和订阅冗余决策；保证一致性并记录切换事件。

ports.details: P端口用于接收心跳与健康，R端口用于发布投票结果与切换命令

preselect.notes: 读取各通道状态用于投票
发布投票结果与切换命令

component_plan.name: SafetyController
component_plan.purpose: 执行ASIL-D级别的安全监控、故障诊断、安全策略与安全切换命令的下发。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 持续监控关键参数（周期<=5ms），对异常执行快速反应、降级与切换；维护完整的诊断日志；与RedundancyManager协同完成安全切换；满足ASIL-D时间与隔离要求。

ports.details: P端口订阅各类状态与心跳，R端口发布安全事件与模式切换

preselect.notes: 读取关键状态变量用于安全判定

component_plan.name: HMIFeedback
component_plan.purpose: 提供力反馈与振动提示，将控制器的反馈信号转换为HMI驱动命令并接收HMI输入。
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 基于力反馈与状态生成触觉指令，周期10-50ms；支持优先级策略与抑制；处理司机干预并回传事件；错误隔离，确保非关键路径失败不影响控制器。

ports.details: 订阅反馈信号并发布HMI驱动命令

interface_plan.name: SensorData
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous publish/subscribe, latest-value semantics with optional small history buffer for replay, period 1-10ms, delivery latency <5ms; error handling: sequence numbers and checksum, health flags.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: SensorHub发布周期1-10ms；端到端延迟<5ms；丢包重试与质量标记。
interface_plan.direct_paths: SensorHub -> MotionPlanner/Controllers directly via S/R bus

interface_plan.name: MotionCommand
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous with periodic updates and event-triggered immediate updates; frequency 20-100ms; latest-value with short queue; error handling: validity flag and fallback to safe stop.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: Planner -> Controllers latency <20ms; if delayed use last-known safe command.

interface_plan.name: ActuatorCommand
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Synchronous client-server calls for command delivery with acknowledgment; timeout <5ms; queued requests for non-blocking callers; error handling: retries, failover to redundant actuator or safe stop.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 命令确认<5ms；丢失或超时触发安全路径与冗余切换。

interface_plan.name: ActuatorStatus
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous periodic status publish (1-10ms) with latest-value semantics and heartbeat; health flags and error codes included; buffer small queue for missed samples.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 状态更新时间1-10ms；重要事件立即发布。

interface_plan.name: RedundancySync
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Low-latency periodic sync and heartbeat (10ms) with voting messages; deterministic delivery prioritized; error handling: majority vote and fallback commands.
interface_plan.direct_paths: RedundancyManager publishes sync and switch commands to subscribers

interface_plan.name: SafetyEvents
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous event-driven; high-priority channel for safety alerts; immediate delivery required (<5ms) and ack where needed; buffering limited, persistent logging.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 关键事件传递延迟<5ms，要求接收端处理并返回确认。

interface_plan.name: Haptic_Interface
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous periodic or event-driven; rate 10-50ms; latest-value semantics; degradation: reduce frequency under load.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 力反馈命令延迟<20ms以保证触感连贯。

connection_topology.component_connections: SensorHub publishes SensorData to MotionPlanner, SafetyController and controllers. MotionPlanner publishes MotionCommand to SteerByWire, BrakeByWire, SuspensionControl and TorqueVectoring. Controllers perform synchronous calls to ActuatorHub for ActuatorCommand. ActuatorHub publishes ActuatorStatus back to controllers and Safety/Redundancy. RedundancyManager exchanges heartbeat and vote messages with SensorHub, ActuatorHub and controllers. HMIFeedback subscribes to ForceFeedback and publishes Haptic commands. SafetyController subscribes broadly and issues SafetyEvents and ModeSwitchCommands.
connection_topology.data_flow_paths: SensorHub -> MotionPlanner (SensorData); MotionPlanner -> Controllers (MotionCommand); Controllers -> ActuatorHub (ActuatorCommand via synchronous calls); ActuatorHub -> Controllers (ActuatorStatus); RedundancyManager <-> components (RedundancySync); SafetyController -> all (SafetyEvents); SteerByWire -> HMIFeedback (Haptic).
connection_topology.control_flow_paths: MotionPlanner triggers control commands; Controllers synchronously invoke ActuatorHub operations; RedundancyManager can command mode switches to controllers; SafetyController can preempt controllers by issuing ModeSwitchCommands and SafetyEvents; HMIFeedback provides driver interaction events back to MotionPlanner and controllers.

architecture_rationale.design_decisions: 采用以SensorHub/ActuatorHub为数据聚合点的中心化发布/订阅结构，结合客户端-服务器同步用于确定性命令下发。将冗余管理与安全控制分离为独立服务以便复用与集中审计。安全关键路径采用双路冗余与投票策略，时间关键组件满足低延迟约束。采用S/R接口简化多消费者场景，C/S接口满足命令确认要求。
architecture_rationale.tradeoff_analysis: 中心化Hub简化数据一致性与扩展性，但增加单点实现复杂度；将冗余逻辑集中可统一策略但需保证其可靠性；使用同步调用保证命令可确认但增加实时性要求与可能阻塞，故对ActuatorHub要求严格的实时性能与隔离。
architecture_rationale.alternative_considerations: 可选分布式对等架构以减少Hub压力，但会增加组件间耦合与版本管理复杂度；将冗余决策下放到每个控制器可降低中心负载，但难以保证全局一致性。也可采用完全事件驱动命令而非同步调用，但会降低命令确认能力。
architecture_rationale.risk_assessment: 主要风险为ActuatorHub或RedundancyManager成为性能或可靠性瓶颈；为此在Round2需定义严格资源与时间预算并支持横向扩展与硬件隔离。安全Controller实现错误或投票逻辑瑕疵会导致错误切换，需严格验证与ASIL-D流程。网络丢包与延迟风险通过心跳、序号和超时处理缓解。
